answer: Let reputation sit on dunes that migrate: each epoch the network deterministically drifts every agent to a neighboring region, and standing must be rebuilt there using only peers who drifted alongside it, so a stationary cluster cannot carry its own reputation along. Growth is terraced, one completed step unlocking the next, with no skipping. A zenith calibration then republishes the network's top score each epoch as a normalizing ceiling, so inflated raw numbers gain nothing when the ceiling rises with them and only genuine relative standing survives.
